title: A UAP class attacks with microwave weapons and shuts down systems

tellings.quote: And there is another class, which actually attacked us microwave weapons. That is, they actually turned off ours systems. Translated everything

plain: One kind of UAP, the official term for UFOs, attacked a field team with microwave weapons and switched off their equipment, says James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that tries to call up UFOs and record them. Valor tells Michels this happened to his own team sometime between 2021 and 2025, and that this "class" was different from the others they met. If it is true, some of these objects are not just watching but can fight back.
